attempts.summary: Joined node1, node2, node3 into a single RabbitMQ 3.13.7 cluster (CentOS Stream 10, Erlang 26 via RabbitMQ's official packagecloud el/9 repos since el/10 packages don't exist yet), created the `payments` vhost with an `app_user` account (full configure/write/read permissions on that vhost), and a durable quorum queue `orders` replicated across all three nodes. Verified messages published to the queue survive the loss of any single node and remain consumable from the surviving nodes. Completed the mandatory node-restart evidence protocol for all three nodes via `systemctl reboot`, confirming changed boot_id and full service/data/cluster recovery each time while maintaining quorum.
